name: Unbiased Score Distillation
definition: A distillation strategy that rectifies critical bias in traditional radiance field optimization by substituting the biased unconditional noise predictions of a multi-view diffuser with unconditioned noise from a pre-trained 2D diffusion model.
summary: Unbiased Score Distillation is a training loss for radiance fields that replaces biased multi-view noise predictions with true unconditional noise from a 2D diffusion model to ensure multi-view consistency.
